stories.sum: The artist Peter Max has died at age 88

stories.sum: The artificial intelligence company also released a framework for reporting when its systems go wrong.

stories.title: Tyra Banks wiped her social media, launches a Substack: ‘The World of Too Much’
stories.sum: How did “America’s Next Top Model” captivate a generation of millennials? Here’s one reason: Showrunner and mastermind Tyra Banks loves to be extra.

stories.title: Madrid’s Museo Nacional Thyssen-Bornemisza to Open New Contemporary Art Space
stories.sum: The institution will repurpose a disused building to house works worth €16 million donated by Francesca Thyssen‑Bornemisza, daughter of the museum’s founder.

stories.title: S&P Global to acquire blockchain security platform OpenZeppelin
stories.sum: S&P Global agreed to buy OpenZeppelin, which says its smart contracts have facilitated more than $37 trillion in value transfers.

stories.title: State hackers drive 420% surge in onchain malware, Chainalysis finds
stories.sum: North Korea-linked hackers used Tron, Aptos and BNB Chain to maintain malware infrastructure, while suspected Iran-linked actors embedded directions in Bitcoin transactions.

stories.title: Renoir Show Breaks Box-Office Record at London’s National Gallery
stories.sum: Ticket sales for the National Gallery’s forthcoming Renoir exhibition have topped twenty-two thousand, setting a record for the London institution.

stories.title: Macklemore donates $1 million of his Ed Sheeran tour earnings to Palestine after being dropped
stories.sum: Macklemore is donating the $1 million he has earned from Ed Sheeran 's Loop tour to organisations supporting Palestinians.

stories.title: A New Digital Platform, Documenting the Basilica of Saint Francis of Assisi and Its Masterpieces by Giotto and Cimabue, Has Launched
stories.sum: Preserving Assisi allows users to virtually explore the sacred space, while establishing a detailed record that will be used to support research and conservation.

stories.title: FCA Guidance Lands Two Weeks Before UK Crypto Authorization Window Opens
stories.sum: Overseas firms serving UK retail customers need authorization too, and nobody trades under the new rules before October 2027.

stories.title: Meta is learning a lesson about camera glasses that Google learned more than 10 years ago
stories.sum: Google Glass taught Google that camera glasses make people uncomfortable. Now, Meta is reportedly developing a camera-free version of its AI glasses.

stories.title: Bolstered by New Laws, Lawsuits in Los Angeles Renew Bids for Restitution of Nazi-Looted Art
stories.sum: Monday’s lawsuits are the first such cases filed in California that could benefit from new legislation designed to help recover Nazi-looted art.

stories.title: Residents file lawsuit challenging noise pollution from Elon Musk's data center
stories.sum: The loud noise from massive gas turbines never stops at Elon Musk's data center near Memphis. Residents are suing.

stories.title: A Mathematician Just Debunked a Parthenon Myth
stories.sum: The structure's famed optical illusions are, in fact, an illusion. The post A Mathematician Just Debunked a Parthenon Myth appeared first on Artnet News .

stories.title: Comment | Sunil Gupta’s intimate photographs show how art and activism can work together
stories.sum: The images in the British-Indian artist’s retrospective at Kettle's Yard in Cambridge, England, are both tender and powerful
